Built a playable, original Unova-inspired creature RPG in `index.html`. It has a dual-screen handheld layout, three starter partners, turn-based battles, type advantages, capture orbs, healing items, a party screen, progression, and automatic saves. It’s an original homage—not an exact Pokémon Black recreation.

Checked the game in the browser through starter selection and the first battle. Assumption: a compact, self-contained browser game was the best fit for the NDS-style request. Start it with `./start.sh` in the project environment.
